title: API: an unknown status is refused and an empty inactive list returns 200
custom_preconds: A location with no inactive parts.
custom_steps:
1. GET /api/inventory/parts?status=retired (also export and count-sheet-pdf)
  2. GET /api/inventory/parts?status=inactive at the empty location
custom_expected:
1. 400 {"errors":[{"status":"Status must be one of: active, inactive, all."}]} on all three
  2. 200 with an empty collection
